tagline: A room with the harbour in it
sector: A fourteen-room design-led micro-hotel in a converted harbour warehouse, sold direct.
founded_place_size: Opened 2023 on the Nordhavn waterfront, Copenhagen; fourteen rooms run by one small owner-led team.
about: Nordhaven is a fourteen-room hotel inside a converted brick and timber warehouse on the working harbour. We sell the feeling of the building: cold light, plaster, oak and brass. Guests choose us because the place looks like nowhere else, and everything we make has to carry that.
audience: Design-literate urban travellers, 30 to 45, who choose a property on aesthetic and book direct once they trust the point of view.
price_positioning: Six hundred dollars a night, direct only, positioned above the travel-platform grid as a design destination rather than a room count.
typography: A quiet high-contrast serif for display, set large and used sparingly, with a clean neutral grotesque for text. Nothing shouts, and rates sit small.
voice: Spare, understated, first person, no exclamation. Example line: 'Fourteen rooms on the water. We open direct booking this autumn.'
brand_assets_status: We work from a short brand note that fixes the near-black ground, the placements and the delivered sizes. There is no full guideline system yet, and the room list changes each season.
values: One committed tone across everything, with the true-colour main room photograph kept as the single deliberate exception so guests see the actual bed and linen.
